data.title: 泽塔 · 窗边的猫式午睡
data.description: 据点的窗边，午后阳光正好。泽塔抱着靠垫蜷成一团睡着了，耳朵偶尔轻轻抖一下——就算睡着，金豹的警觉也没有完全放下。
data.location: hideout window seat with cushions, afternoon sunlight and a view of rooftops
data.action: 抱着靠垫蜷成一团睡着了，耳朵偶尔轻轻抖一下——就算睡着，金豹的警觉也没有完全放下
data.promptProse: Curled loosely along a cushioned wooden window seat inside a quiet afternoon hideout, Zeta naps in her oversized grey cat-ear hoodie and shorts with her arms wrapped lightly around a soft throw pillow. Her eyes stay peacefully closed, yet her posture retains a subtle feline poise above the distant tiled rooftops visible through the tall casement glass. Warm golden afternoon sunlight slants across the sheer curtains, cushions, and her resting form.
data.animaCaption: Curled on the cushioned window seat in her oversized grey hoodie, Zeta sleeps with her eyes closed and arms wrapped loosely around a soft pillow. Warm afternoon sunlight pours across the sill and sheer curtains above the distant town rooftops.
